summary: 62.1% packet loss on SPAN destination CORE-SW-01 Gi1/0/48: 2.64 Gbps mirrored from Gi1/0/1 into 1 Gbps IDS port, IDS severely blinded.

findings.root_cause: SPAN oversubscription at CORE-SW-01: session should copy 19,807,440 packets (2.64 Gbps) from mirrored port Gi1/0/1 to SPAN destination Gi1/0/48 (1 Gbps). Destination averaged 100% load and discarded 12,307,500 packets on output (62.14% lost, 7,500,000 sent vs 19,807,440 expected). SPAN has no buffering and drops under sustained oversubscription plus bursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs both directions and full payload but misses 62% of packets. Stateful signatures, flow reassembly, and detection of exploits/C2/exfiltration fail with massive false negatives; IDS is effectively blind to more than half of traffic.

params.broker_requirement: packet broker to aggregate TAP feed and load-balance to IDS

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, out-of-band copy unlike SPAN which discards when mirrored rate exceeds destination rate. Replacing SPAN with TAP plus a packet broker allows lossless capture of the full 2.64 Gbps and load-balancing/filtering across multiple 1 Gbps IDS ports or upgrading IDS to 10 Gbps, eliminating the 62% blind spot.
